contract_answer.question: On split 42, does the NA-E026 degradation-law configuration improve MAPE over NA-E010 and contribute to satisfying the fixed three-split A5-NA accuracy, law-fit, and balance rule?
contract_answer.conclusion: Reviewer recomputation from 600 selected-checkpoint predictions confirms MAPE 0.112137, Acc@15 0.728333, and RMSE 40.1419 cycles at epoch 45. MAPE improves over matched parent NA-E010 (0.116952), so the split-local results.tsv rule gives KEEP. Held-out law-fit error is 0.0332 versus parent 0.0348 and true-EOL floor 0.0277; excess falls from 0.0071 to 0.0055 (22.5%). Balance passes with median R 0.556. Across all three confirmations, however, A5-NA is refuted because mean law-fit excess falls only 15.6%, not the required 30%.
